careerplug.notes: 2024 data, 10M+ applications, small businesses: ~180 applicants per hire, 3% interviewed

encouragement.applied: This is the starting line, and it's the same for everyone: most applications stop here, usually before a person reads them. The next step, a first call, makes your odds about {multiplier_next} times better.
encouragement.screening: A person picked you out. Your odds are now about {multiplier_from_applied} times better than when you applied.
encouragement.interview: You've gone from about 1 in {one_in_applied} to about 1 in {one_in_here}. Very few applicants get this far. This is where preparation makes the biggest difference.
encouragement.rejected_fast: Probably no person saw your CV, so this is not a judgement of it.
encouragement.rejected_after_interview: Getting to interview means your CV and experience were competitive. One no at this stage is common, even for people who get an offer soon after.
